source_title: Search Engine Land — How to make SEO reports more actionable
method_point: Research must be translated into specific next steps; prioritization should account for impact/effort/dependency/timing; measurement and ownership should be explicit where known.
step19_defect_exposed: Analytical priority/action views were correct but stopped before a calibration-ready execution interface and measurement surface.
correction_requirement: Add 112-package calibration board; keep unknown execution inputs explicit; add acceptance/baseline/metric/window/decision-rule measurement protocol.

method_point: Group by intent, map topics to pages, set action and assignment in a usable mapping artifact.
step19_defect_exposed: Semantic mapping existed canonically but client deliverable 03 required manual joins across internal TSVs.
correction_requirement: Materialize full semantic client sheet mechanically from canonical sources; generated view must not become competing authority.

source_title: Ahrefs — How to Build an SEO Topical Map
method_point: Map existing/new URLs, account for business relevance/value and move follow-up tasks into implementation workflow.
step19_defect_exposed: Page architecture was strong, but business/execution calibration fields were not surfaced as an operational handoff.
correction_requirement: Expose business-priority state separately from public relevance and create implementation calibration fields/workflow without guessed values.

source_title: Semrush — What is an SEO report?
method_point: Effective reports need executive summary, contextual performance/opportunity explanation and specific recommendations in a stakeholder-usable report.
step19_defect_exposed: Repo-native Markdown/TSV/JSON package was analytically strong but not a polished standalone external delivery surface.
correction_requirement: Generate standalone DOCX/PDF narrative plus workbook; keep raw technical artifacts as supporting evidence.

method_point: Yandex Webmaster exposes query/URL visibility metrics including impressions, clicks, CTR and position.
step19_defect_exposed: Step19 stated that recheck triggers are not success metrics but did not provide an operational measurement table.
correction_requirement: Define future optional first-party measurement sources/metrics without inventing current values or targets.

source_title: Yandex Webmaster — Расширенная аналитика поисковых запросов по URL
method_point: URL-query export includes date, host, URL, query, region, clicks, impressions and position.
step19_defect_exposed: No per-action baseline/measurement-source interface existed despite an available future governed data route.
correction_requirement: Add query→URL measurement route as OPTIONAL_FUTURE_IF_AUTHORIZED; keep current base-public job status explicit.

method_point: Clear page/section link structure supports users and crawler understanding.
step19_defect_exposed: No defect in analytical architecture; external evidence reinforces exact owner/support/internal-link implementation.
correction_requirement: Preserve existing exact owner/support/link recommendations; do not turn correction into new architecture research.
